statements.text: He is unlikely to see Venus clearly because clouds and bright lights block a clear dark view.
He will see Venus clearly because it is above the horizon at that clock time alone.
Switching on more terrace lights will make Venus easier to find against the clouds.

stem: Mohan plans to spot Venus from his terrace at 7:30 p.m. Venus is above the horizon, but thick cloud covers the whole sky and nearby street lamps stay bright.

teacher.key_rationale: Observation needs a clear enough sky and suitable darkness as well as the object being above the horizon. Clouds and bright lights block the view; more lights make it worse, not better.
